statement.zh: Blegen & Rawson 1966 出版说明称皮洛斯迈锡尼行政中心在公元前 13 世纪末毁于火且未再占用。
statement.en: Blegen & Rawson 1966 publisher summary states the Mycenaean administrative center at Pylos was destroyed by fire at the end of the 13th century B.C. and not reoccupied.

editorial.notes: Derived only from civ MD + registered sources. No new archaeological inventions.
